tagline: Fabless provider of high-performance analog and mixed-signal power electronics solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: MPWR's revenue growth is driven by Storage and Computing (26.3% of 2025 revenue) and Enterprise Data (25.2% of 2025 revenue) segments, reflecting exposure to data center and cloud infrastructure trends. The company's fabless model and focus on energy-efficient, integrated power management solutions position it to benefit from increasing power demands in enterprise computing infrastructure.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue amounts to $2,790.5 million for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, an increase of 26.4% compared to 2024 ($2,207.1 million).
kpis.signal: Revenue growth in the analog semiconductor sector.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin reaches 55.2% of revenue in 2025, compared to 55.3% in 2024, reflecting excellent production efficiency.
kpis.signal: Stable gross margin above the semiconductor sector average.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin stands at 26.1% in 2025, compared to 24.4% in 2024, demonstrating strong operational profitability and excellent cost control.
kpis.signal: Exceptional operating margin, higher than most semiconductor peers.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Amount spent on research and development as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses represent 13.7% of revenue in 2025 ($382.3 million), down from 14.7% in 2024, reflecting continued investment in product innovation.
kpis.signal: Controlled R&D investment while maintaining innovation in analog and mixed-signal technologies.

kpis.name: SG&A Expenses (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses represent 15.4% of revenue in 2025 ($428.8 million), down from 16.2% in 2024, indicating strong control over administrative costs.
kpis.signal: Operational efficiency with well-managed SG&A expenses.

kpis.name: Net Margin
kpis.explanation: Net profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Net margin reaches 22.3% in 2025 ($621.5 million net profit), compared to 72.1% in 2024 which benefited from a significant tax credit of $1.019 billion.
kpis.signal: Exceptional net margin, though reduced compared to 2024 due to a negative tax adjustment in the prior year.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: The company employs over 4,500 people across various locations in Asia, Europe and the United States.
kpis.signal: Significant global workforce distributed across Asia, Europe and the United States.

kpis.name: Storage & Computing Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Storage and Computing segment, expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: The Storage and Computing segment represents 26.3% of revenue in 2025 ($732.5 million), compared to 22.7% in 2024, reflecting robust growth in data centers.
kpis.signal: Key growth segment benefiting from increased demand in storage and computing.

kpis.name: Enterprise Data Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Enterprise Data segment, expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: The Enterprise Data segment represents 25.2% of revenue in 2025 ($701.8 million), compared to 32.5% in 2024, reflecting some normalization following a strong 2024 performance.
kpis.signal: Major segment in slight correction, but still highly significant for MPWR.

ai_positioning.summary: MPWR does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report. However, the company's exposure to the Storage and Computing and Enterprise Data segments suggests indirect exposure to AI and data center trends.
